newsitem.title: USA: Stormedia sees Q3 shr loss of $0.50.
newsitem.headline: Stormedia sees Q3 shr loss of $0.50.

text.p: StorMedia Inc said Monday it expects a loss of about $0.50 a share for its third quarter, ended September 27, on revenues of about $40 million.

The company said the weaker results were caused largely because its Tuas facility in Singapore, which is currently idle, was significantly underutilized during the quarter because Maxtor Corp terminated volume purchase agreements.
StorMedia said in a statement it has filed a lawsuit in the U.S. District Court seeking damages against Maxtor and its parent company Hyundai Electronics Industries Co Ltd.

The comapny said that in an effort to replace the void created by the sudden Hyundai breach it accelerated qualification and production of new products with significantly lower yields and gross margins.
